changes: Implemented review_run_start workspace diagnostics: core snapshot capture now distinguishes non-git, missing HEAD, and missing materialHash; handler resolves one canonical story worktree before phase checks and before any currentReviewRound repair; context helper rejects ctx.root/worktree mismatches; field regression smoke now covers direct REVIEW success, no-write failure cases, missing materialHash, wrong cwd, and stale root mismatch.
usage: Run lattice review_run_start from the story worktree for a REVIEW story. If the workspace cannot provide a valid local HEAD/materialHash snapshot, the command exits before writing review-run metadata or repairing currentReviewRound and prints the exact workspace diagnostic and next action.
expectedOutcome: Direct REVIEW reviewer runs succeed only from a valid story worktree with real HEAD/materialHash; non-git, unborn HEAD, empty material tree, wrong cwd, or ctx.root mismatch fail closed without local evidence mutation and without claiming Authority Server receipt semantics.
actualTranscript: PASS: lattice story_advance B-3787 REVIEW to TEST; PASS: lattice validate --story=B-3787 --json with allPass true and 10/10 verificationIntent coverage; PASS: delivery_check_set with 2 realMachineTests and no unverified doc promises. Earlier targeted smokes passed: build, field-regression-cli-smoke, review-loop-smoke, authority-boundary-smoke, authority-gate-consumption, and baseline-local-certification-smoke.
outcomeDiff: No behavior diff against the intended outcome for review_run_start; failures now occur at the correct workspace/snapshot boundary and successful runs remain local signed REVIEW evidence only.
limitations: No known limitation in the implemented review_run_start behavior. One pre-existing unrelated smoke, test:worktree-authority-smoke, still expects an English DONE merge line while current CLI emits Chinese text; this was not changed because it is outside the review_run_start correctness scope.
pitfalls: The important ordering pitfall was reading story phase from a stale ctx.root before resolving the story worktree, which masked root/worktree mismatch as an INIT_CHECK phase error. Another pitfall was repairing legacy currentReviewRound before snapshot readiness; the fix keeps all writes after snapshot diagnosis succeeds.
